name: Nested Repetition (Exponential)
description: Inner repetition '+' inside outer repetition '+' causes 2^N branch possibilities on non-matching suffix.

name: Overlapping Alternation (Exponential)
description: Branches 'a' and 'aa' overlap under repetition, creating ambiguity and combinatorial path explosion.

name: Nested Kleene Star
description: Unbounded star repetition within outer star allows combinatorial epsilon and character partitions.
